title.en: An Act Changing the Names of Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Leyte
title.orig: An Act Changing the Names of Certain Barrios in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Leyte

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1333_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
The names of the following barrios in the Municipality of Naval, Province of Leyte, are changed as follows:
Barrio Catmon to barrio Santo Rosario; barrio Agpangi to barrio La Purisima Concepcion; barrio Lico to barrio San Vicente; barrio Talostusan to barrio Santa Fe; barrio Locso-on to barrio San Isidro; and barrio Villa Caneja to barrio Sulphur Valley.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval Approved: June 16, 1955.
